sasha: Kicking off onboarding for ArgosX-7B int4 on staging. Quick note: small but consistent drop on dialogue-quality bench after quant. Dumping short artifacts and observations here.

nina: paste the eval CLI and numbers?

sasha: eval command (staging):
./bench_runner --model argosx-7b --quant int4-row --prompts bench/dialogue-q --weights /mnt/models/argosx/ckpt_2100 --batch 12 --seed 7

eval-bot: run summary (2026-03-21T02:12Z):
- conv-bleu: fp16=31.2 -> int4=27.4
- resp-f1: 0.642 -> 0.607
- ppl heldout +4.2%

matt: not huge latency change, but quality drop is meaningful. Any conversion notes?

sasha: Converter used default runtime rotary_base=10000. Model repo config lists rotary.base: 8192 and headwise freq_scale 0.985. Also training tokenization used zero-width-space (U+200B) as a soft joiner in some compound tokens; our normalizer strips U+200B.

omar: U+200B is sneaky. Removing it merges tokens that were separate during training. In one sample we saw original tokenizer produce ["highB-trust", " policy"] -> our tokenizer -> ["hightrust", " policy"]. That shifts token ids and KV alignment.

nina: Which fix is cheaper to try first? rotary params or tokenizer tweak?

matt: Rotary tweak is cheap: set rotary_base=8192 and freq_scale=0.985 at runtime and rerun a small subset. If that moves the needle, great. If not, rebuild tokenizer to preserve U+200B and re-eval.

sasha: Ran a 300-example smoke with runtime rotary_base=8192 freq_scale=0.985: conv-bleu recovered to 29.6 (from 27.4), resp-f1 -> 0.626. Partially recovered, still below fp16.

omar: Good signal. Next: try tokenizer-preserve-U200B micro-run. Note: if we change tokenizer, validate streaming chunk boundaries and kv-cache sanity. Token shifts can affect cached prefix matching.

sasha: Uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-staging/argosx/ckpt_2100/rotary-smoke-20260321.tar.gz and tokenizer diffs at https://redwood.internal/git/argosx/tokenizer/preserve-u200b

nina: Can you open a ticket with the three run IDs and tag eng-ml + eng-platform? We'll need a conversion-time lint that checks model config rotary vs runtime defaults.

sasha: Created issue #12510 and assigned to @omar. Run IDs: rot-only-518, tok-only-519, combined-520. Link: https://redwood.internal/issue/12510

matt: If tokenizer-preserve closes most of the remaining gap, let's add a conversion flag to keep the invisible joiner and a tiny unit test that replays ~200 training-era strings to catch token id drift. Also add a note to rollout docs about checking rotary family params.

eval-bot: follow-ups queued: rot-only (job 518901), tok-preserve (job 518902), combined (job 518903). ETA 2026-03-21T08:00Z.

sasha: Thanks all. Will post final numbers when jobs complete. :thumbsup:
